findings.title: Exclusive JSON creation is visible before complete durable publication
findings.minimum_fix: Fully write and fsync an owned exclusive same-directory temporary file, then atomically publish without replacing an existing receipt; add concurrent-publication refusal fixtures.

findings.title: Normal ACK uses historical known identity without current live PID or matching GCS PID proof
findings.minimum_fix: Before ACK re-observe the registered identity with stable before/after live snapshots and require the exact GCS PID to match; absent, reused or mismatched identities must not receive ACK.

findings.title: Detached actor may pass as DEAD without post-driver survival or parent-owned release
findings.minimum_fix: Require explicit post-driver detached survival and bound live identity, parent release action, and final DEAD plus original PID absence before scenario success.

findings.title: Missing ready receipt does not prove controlled exit happened before creation returned
findings.minimum_fix: Use an explicit bounded CPU constructor or stage barrier with positive evidence preserving the intended pre-return window until parent control; a missed window must fail without retry.
